user.title: Aigües Vic virtual office
user.description: Sign in with the credentials of the Aigües Vic virtual office. They are only used to read your contracts and consumption.

data_description.email: Email used to sign in to the virtual office.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the password
reauth_confirm.description: The virtual office rejected the password for {email}. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the virtual office. Try again later.
error.no_contracts: The account has no active contracts.
error.unknown: Unexpected response from the virtual office.

data_description.import_history: Imports all consumption available on the portal into the water statistics, once per contract. It may take a few minutes.
data_description.price_per_m3: Price per m³ used to build the cost statistic for the energy dashboard. Use the variable part of the bill; 0 disables it.

invalid_auth.message: The virtual office rejected the credentials.

update_failed.message: Could not update data from the virtual office ({error}).

sync_failed.message: Could not synchronize with the virtual office. Check the logs.

reimport_failed.message: Could not import the statistics again ({error}).

entry_not_loaded.message: The Aigües Vic account is not loaded.

invalid_start_date.message: The start date must be between {first} and {last}.

update_failed.title: Aigües Vic cannot reach the virtual office
update_failed.description: The last {failures} updates for {account} failed ({error}). The integration keeps retrying with increasing delays. Check that the virtual office works and see the logs of `custom_components.aigues_vic`. This notice disappears after the next successful update.

statistics_failed.title: Aigües Vic cannot import water statistics
statistics_failed.description: The last {failures} statistics imports for {account} failed ({error}). The energy dashboard may be missing recent consumption. The integration keeps retrying; see the logs of `custom_components.aigues_vic`. This notice disappears after the next successful import.

reimport.name: Reimport statistics
reimport.description: Imports the water statistics of every contract of an account again, from a day, or everything, until yesterday.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Aigües Vic account to reimport.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First day to import again. Leave empty to import everything the virtual office has, going back until there is no more data.
